pr_title: Validate Number value before calling entity method

<!--

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
The `number` integration supports the `set_value` method to set the numbers value.
The attributes `min_value` and `max_value` should be checked by the platform before they are passed to the entry method.
If a passed `value` is not between  `min_value` and `max_value`  a `ValueError` should be raised. But this not happening.
This PR add this functionality to the number platform and updates the tests for the `demo` platform.

issue_context.title: Number integration - no value validation
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The `number` integration supports the `set_value` and `async_set_value` method to set the entities value.
The `NumberEntity` class, introduced to support integratations, supports the attributes `min_value` and `max_value`. Values passed to `set_value` should be checked by the platform before they are passed to the entry method.
If a passed `value` is not between  `min_value` and `max_value`  a `ValueError` should be raised.
But this not happening when an invalid value is passed.


### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

dev
